conceptZh: 橡膠恐龍用短手怎麼也搬不動「口」，道具一直滑開，牠呆住的那一刻，口自己飄下來放在「木」上。
object: rubber dinosaur, a slippery mouth box and a tree shape
morph: 口 settles on top of 木
creativeAngle: 道具不聽話，主角放棄發呆時反而成功。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a pale-turquoise stage with a cream floor; the glyph is bold chocolate-brown 呆, a 口 square above a 木. A rubber dinosaur with huge feet and tiny arms stands at left, a loose box and a tree shape lie on the floor. The Traditional Chinese glyph 呆 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the dino squats and tries to scoop up the box with both tiny arms; it slides out and spins away; the first 呆 is spoken as the box slides. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): it chases the box, trips on its own feet and knocks the tree shape upright; the dino freezes mid-reach with a blank face, and the box floats lazily down onto the tree top with a soft click; the second 呆 is spoken at the click. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): the dino stares forward with half-closed eyes and its tiny arms hanging; a fluffy dust mote drifts past its nose and the dino does not react; 發呆 is spoken as the mote passes. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 呆 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the dino slowly blinks once, then slowly blinks again, tilts its head; the glyph is still. Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, reading exactly these syllables with clear tones and no erhua: 「呆、呆、發呆」 (ㄉㄞ、ㄉㄞ、ㄈㄚ ㄉㄞ). Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.6s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only soft thumps and one slide whistle, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
